def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    N = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    X = list(map(int, data[2:2+M]))

    total_length = 0
    bridge_impact = [0] * N

    for i in range(M - 1):
        s, t = X[i], X[i + 1]
        if s > t:
            s, t = t, s
        total_length += t - s
        bridge_impact[s] += 1
        bridge_impact[t] -= 1

    for i in range(1, N):
        bridge_impact[i] += bridge_impact[i - 1]

    min_tour_length = total_length
    for i in range(1, N):
        min_tour_length = min(min_tour_length, total_length - bridge_impact[i])

    print(min_tour_length)
